status: Passed the automated gate. Awaiting sign-off: run python -m src.approve before any real use.
intended_use: Help clinicians decide which adult inpatients get extra follow-up before discharge, by ranking patients on their risk of readmission within 30 days. A person makes the decision. The model only suggests.
not_for: Automated decisions about care, any use on real patients, or any population that differs from the synthetic training data.
known_limits: The data is synthetic, so the scores say nothing about real patients.
Signal is weak. About four in five flagged patients are not readmitted.
No date or site column, so a time-based or site-based check was not possible.
Fairness was checked by sex and age band only. No ethnicity or Indigenous status data exists.
Patients outside the age range 18 to 100 were removed, so the model says nothing about children.
